description: Jev 1.13 (`jev-1.13.0`) remains listed alongside Jev 1.14 in the official Current models table (2026-10-26). It is TypeSafe AI's System One model, served by one vendor-native endpoint: `POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone`. It does not generate text. A caller posts a `state` plus a map of typed questions (Choice / Score / Noul) and gets back one typed decision per question, each with a calibrated probability and a confidence value that application code branches on. Input is text only; default context is 64k tokens per request and 32k per-question. `outputModalities` reads `text` because the catalog's modality vocabulary has no token for typed structured values; the model emits no free-form string.
